mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals tightening monetary policy, compressing equity discount rates and reducing future cash flow present value, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of instances during periods of rising FEDFUNDS rates, or Rank IC >0.05 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Rapid increase in unemployment claims (PAYEMS) indicates weakening labor market conditions, raising concerns about economic slowdown and reduced corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive despite a >10% rise in PAYEMS within the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in demand (GDPC1) coupled with a contraction in supply (INDPRO) creates upward pressure on prices and wage growth, signaling economic overheating and prompting market anticipation of inflation, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases by >5% and INDPRO decreases by >2% in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 rises >5% and INDPRO falls >2% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of low inflation expectations (CPIAUCSL < 300) and accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 5.0%), market participants anticipate sustained economic growth and lower interest rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
regime_hint: low inflation and monetary easing regime
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns over 60 days are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during periods meeting CPIAUCSL < 300 and FEDFUNDS < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Rapid expansion of production (INDPRO rising >5% monthly) indicates strong business activity and potential for sustained corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative despite INDPRO increasing by >5% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.0%) signals a robust labor market, fostering confidence in corporate earnings and economic growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative despite UNRATE falling below 3.0% in the current month.

mechanism_narrative: Despite rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS >5%), a concurrent surge in economic demand (GDPC1 >3% increase) suggests strong growth expectations that dominate the discount rate impact, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS >5% and GDPC1 increases by >3% in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both FEDFUNDS >5% and GDPC1 rises >3% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A dual signal of strong labor market (UNRATE < 3.5%) and falling unemployment claims (PAYEMS < 200,000) indicates robust employment conditions, fostering market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns over 60 days are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during periods where UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS < 200,000.
